evidence: Walk there and back on the Webb Creek Track (6 – 7 hr 30 min)
From the road end car park, walk to the swing bridge to cross the Kauaeranga River.
Pinnacles Hut and Dancing Camp Campsite are a short walk down signposted side tracks.
Return the same way, or return to the Hydro Camp and take the Billygoat Track back to the road end.

From here it is another 40 min downhill to the Kauaeranga Valley Road which requires crossing the Kauaeranga River to the Tarawaere car park.
Walk 300 m north along the road to get back to the road end car park.

doubts: Start ref F2 (unnamed track meeting Kauaeranga Valley Road) is taken as the road end car park because it is the road end furthest up the valley; the packet does not name the car park's feature. F3 (where Billygoat Walk meets the road) is taken as the Tarawaere car park, 300 m from the road end per the text, and map track T2 'Billygoat Walk' as the Billygoat Track; both are inferences. DOC's '3 hr one way' / '6 km one way' summary is for the way out to Pinnacles Hut; the main way is recorded as there and back on the Webb Creek Track as listed in the walking options, whose 6 – 7 hr 30 min may include the Pinnacles summit side trip. Pinnacles Hut is reached by a short signposted side track off the Pinnacles Track. The text's Billygoat Landing directions ('first track on your right … Second on your right you keep follow the Webb Creek Track') are garbled; Billygoat Landing is recorded as a short side trip near the start. The shorter Billygoat Circuit is a separate linked walk that this page does not describe, so it is not recorded as a way. The circuit's direction (up Webb Creek, down Billygoat) is how it is described, but not stated as clockwise or anticlockwise.
